title: Test every interior coordinate
invariant: After testing coordinate x against a prefix of rows, crossed equals the number of those rows without an internal edge at x; best is the minimum from completed coordinates.

frames.explanation: The line must lie strictly inside the wall; both outside boundaries are excluded.
